message: The compile-time type '{0}' has a primary constructor, which is not supported in compile-time code. Remove the parameter list from the type and declare an explicit constructor instead.
rationale: The current message has a grammar defect ('uses non-record primary constructors which is not', plural subject with a singular verb and no comma before the relative clause), and a type has at most one primary constructor. The report site (TemplatingCodeValidator.Visitor, VisitTypeDeclaration) only checks classes and structs, so 'non-record' is implied and can be dropped from the message.
